positions.question: Do you support a decrease in income taxes in order to balance the budget?

evidence.text: "It’s time to rein in inflation once and for all. That means cutting government spending, lowering taxes, and putting America First in our trade policies. Michigan families continue to be plagued by high gas prices, high food prices, and high home heating prices."

"The Biden-Slotkin inflation tax is costing Americans an extra $5,200 a year. Mid-Michigan families are struggling due to reckless Democrat policies. We need leaders who will cut taxes, reduce spending, and unleash American energy to give Michiganders the relief they deserve."
